title: Retro computing stories vs puzzles and games of skill stories on points
question: Does a story about retro computing get more points than a story about puzzles and games of skill?
author: film-cards
hypothesis: A story about retro computing gets more points than a story about puzzles and games of skill.
expect: If true, points per story for retro computing stories should be at least 1.5x the value for puzzles and games of skill stories, over all stories from 2006 to 2026 (1.1x is weak, 0.9x or lower refutes it).

check.per_label: points per story, retro computing against puzzles and games of skill

group_b.label: Puzzles and games of skill stories ({from} to {to})

thresholds_note: Thresholds are the ones used on h370, set before this card was run and not tuned to its result. h362 is left unchanged.
caveats: Points are the score each story had when the archive fetched it, so 2025 and 2026 stories may still be gaining points.
A title that names a theme is not proof the story is about it, and one story can sit in both groups.
Both groups are title words only, so stories that never name the theme are missed.
h362 asked a different question; this card compares two groups head to head.
